stances_toward.note: Rival, not adversary, by the ontology rule that the grade follows the sources. The brief suggested adversary; no source read says the Mexican state seeks the cartels' defeat or disappearance, and Sheinbaum explicitly denies that the cartels pursue political objectives (Aug 2025), which is the reason she rejects the terrorist label (the FTO designations of Feb 2025 and the additions of July 2026). Competing interests, violence against the state, no will to destroy the other side as a political actor. Trend cooling as the designations grow and the US pressure to act against cartels in Mexico hardens. Since 1 Oct 2024 (Sheinbaum's term); the confrontation predates her.
